lines.t: Who are these I have made?
And what man have I brought forth from the dust of the earth
That I might share my glory with him?
There are none worthy
Not one formed from the dust of the earth
Who knows me
Not one who is righteous
No, not one
Oh, lie down in death
Or return to the dust of the earth
Yet I came down to you
In the image in which I formed you
So you might receive of me
And have a life that you might share
In my wisdom and fire
And healing
Great peace in my love
Exchanging your life for mine
That you might roam free in my creation
Close to me, at my side always
Until your first days are called ancient
And your latter days laughter
Years beyond number
Thousands of years passing as the setting of the sun
Millions of days passing by as a breeze
Caressing the face of the forever young
Each one remembered as yesterday
Says the Lord
Yeah, who's you?
